idea.title: 1-Bit Bonsai Image 4B Image Generation for Local Devices

plan.tagline: Generate 1-bit 4B color bonsai images locally without internet or heavy dependencies
plan.problem: Designers and developers need simple, offline-friendly tools for generating minimalist bonsai art but lack lightweight CLI options without bloated dependencies
plan.solution: A Python CLI that creates 1-bit 4B color bonsai images using only stdlib, with offline demo mode and subscription-based updates for new styles
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses needing lightweight CLI tools for generating minimalist art assets
mvp_features: Offline demo mode with hardcoded samples

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for storing bonsai styles + add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: basic report generation + CLI alerts for updates

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: hardcoded demo mode + help text + edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Run `bonsai4b --demo` to generate 3 sample 1-bit bonsai images with stats. Shows CLI usage and offline capability without downloads.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai tourism businesses could use minimalist bonsai-style icons for offline-friendly marketing materials (menus, flyers) without needing design software
